title: Tola + AI · eight-hour development sprint

rollup.summary: Checkpoint 0.32 local gates pass: native 1,689, PGlite 1,633, product browser 13 groups. Source manifest and review commit are being recorded. Next increment prepares governed programme evidence links and consent-based internal human advice.

limits: The eight-hour deadline is a work window, not a promise that the complete platform will be finished.
There are four active-agent slots including integration; additional workstreams will run in waves.
ETA ranges are forecasts from agents and can change after inspection, review and testing.
Local implementation and passing tests do not establish production acceptance. Native, hosted, container and nonprofit UAT gates remain separate.
Paid provider calls, paid CI, merging and deployment need the owner’s separate approval.
The original requirement registers and their acceptance statuses remain unchanged; no overall completion percentage is inferred.
